info.name: Luxe E-Commerce API
info.description:
All routes of the Luxe backend. The Express server (`backend/server.js`) and the Cloudflare Worker (`backend/src/index.js`) expose the same routes.

## Quick start
1. Pick an environment (top-right): **Luxe - Production**, **Luxe - Local (Express :5000)** or **Luxe - Local (Worker :8787)**.
2. Run the collection in order (**Run collection**), or click through folders 00 → 08.
3. Auth is cookie based. After Signup/Login, Postman's cookie jar sends `accessToken`/`refreshToken` automatically.

## Variables
Scripts fill `productId`, `category`, `stripeSessionId` and `couponCode` as you go. `testEmail` is regenerated on every Signup.

Set `adminEmail`/`adminPassword` in the environment to enable folder 07.

item.name: 00 - Health
item.description: Liveness check. No auth, no database.

request.description: Returns `{ status: "ok" }` when the API is running.

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description:
Authentication is **cookie based**. `signup`, `login` and `refresh-token` set httpOnly `accessToken` (15 min) and `refreshToken` (7 days) cookies. Postman stores them in its cookie jar and sends them automatically on later requests to the same host; no Authorization header is needed.

When you get `401 Unauthorized - Access token expired`, run **Refresh Token**.

request.description:
**Auth:** none

Register a new user and log them in (sets auth cookies).

**Body:** `name`, `email`, `password` (8-64 chars, not a common password).

The pre-request script generates a unique `testEmail` each run so signup never collides. Replace `{{testEmail}}` with a real address to sign up manually.

**Responses:** `201` user object, `400 User already exists`, `500` validation error.

exec: // Fresh email each run so signup does not collide with an existing user
pm.test("returns user with role 'user'", () => { pm.expect(u).to.have.property("_id"); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql("user"); });

request.description:
**Auth:** none

Log in with email + password. Sets `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies.

**Responses:** `200` user object, `400 Invalid email or password`.

**Auth:** none

Shows the error you get with bad credentials. Does not touch the existing cookies.

**Auth:** accessToken cookie (log in first)

Returns the logged-in user (password excluded), including `cartItems` and `role`.

**Auth:** refreshToken cookie

Issues a new 15-minute `accessToken` cookie from the `refreshToken` cookie. The token must match the one stored in Redis.

**Responses:** `200 Token refreshed successfully`, `401 No refresh token provided` / `Invalid refresh token`.

item.name: 02 - Products (Public)
item.description: Read-only product endpoints. No login required.

request.description:
**Auth:** none

Every product in the store: `{ products: [...] }`.

The test script saves the first product's `_id`, `category`, `name`, `price` and `image` into collection variables. Later requests use them, so **run this first**.

exec: // Prefer a product with an image (Stripe needs one) and the lowest price
const p = [...products].filter(x => x.image).sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)[0] || products[0];

request.description:
**Auth:** none

Products with `isFeatured: true`. Served from the Redis cache (`featured_products`) when available. Returns a bare array.

**Auth:** none

Case-insensitive exact match on `category`. Examples: `electronics`, `clothing`, `accessories`, `jewelry`, `home`, `fragrance`.

Returns `{ products: [...] }`.

**Auth:** none

4 random products (`$sample`). Returns a bare array.

**Auth:** none

Single product by Mongo `_id`. `404 Product not found` if it does not exist.

exec: console.log("Skipping - no productId yet. Run 'Products > Get All Products (Public)' first.");

item.name: 03 - Cart
item.description: Cart lives on the user document (`user.cartItems`). All routes require login. Items are keyed by `productId` + `selectedSize`.

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Adds 1 unit of a product. If the same product + size is already in the cart, its quantity goes up by 1.

**Body:** `productId` (required), `selectedSize` (optional, e.g. `"M"` or `"UK 8"`).

Returns the raw `cartItems` array.

exec: console.log("Skipping - no productId yet. Run 'Products > Get All Products (Public)' first.");
pm.test("cart has the product", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(i => i.product === pm.collectionVariables.get("productId"))).to.be.true);

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Cart items joined with full product data, plus `quantity` and `selectedSize`.

**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Sets the quantity of a cart line. `:id` is the **productId**. Send the same `selectedSize` that was used when adding.

`quantity: 0` removes the line. `404 Product not found` if that product + size is not in the cart.

exec: console.log("Skipping - no productId yet. Run 'Products > Get All Products (Public)' first.");

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Removes a single product + size line from the cart.

**Body:** `productId`, `selectedSize`.

exec: console.log("Skipping - no productId yet. Run 'Products > Get All Products (Public)' first.");

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Send an empty JSON body (no `productId`) to empty the whole cart.

The body must still be valid JSON (`{}`), because the handler always parses it.

item.name: 04 - Payments (Stripe)
item.description:
Stripe Checkout flow:
1. **Create Checkout Session** returns `{ id, url, totalAmount }`. Open `url` in a browser and pay (use a Stripe test card in test mode).
2. **Checkout Success** with that session id creates the Order and deactivates any used coupon.

Orders of $200 or more earn the user a 10% `GIFT…` coupon.

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

**Body:**
- `products`: array of `{ _id, name, price, image, quantity }` (`image` must be a public URL, because Stripe fetches it)
- `couponCode`: optional; must belong to the logged-in user

The test saves `stripeSessionId` and `checkoutUrl`. Open `checkoutUrl` in a browser to finish the payment.

exec: console.log("Skipping - no productId yet. Run 'Products > Get All Products (Public)' first.");
pm.test("has session id + url", () => { pm.expect(r.id).to.match(/^cs_/); pm.expect(r.url).to.be.a("string"); });

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Call after Stripe redirects to `/purchase-success?session_id=...`.

**Body:** `sessionId` (Stripe Checkout Session id).

- `200 { success: true, orderId }` if the session is paid
- `400 Payment not completed` if it has not been paid yet (expected in an automated run)

item.name: 05 - Coupons
item.description: Each user can hold at most one active coupon (earned from orders of $200 or more).

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Returns the user's active coupon `{ code, discountPercentage, expirationDate, ... }`, or `null` if they have none.

**Auth:** accessToken cookie

Checks that a coupon code belongs to the user, is active and has not expired. An expired coupon is deactivated on the spot.

**Body:** `code`.

**Responses:** `200 { message, code, discountPercentage }`, `404 Coupon not found` / `Coupon expired`.

If the user has no coupon, the pre-request script sends a fake code, so `404` is the expected result.

item.name: 06 - AI Chat
item.description:
AI shopping assistant. The response is a **Server-Sent Events** stream (`text/event-stream`), not JSON. Each event is `data: {"type": "token" | "done" | "error", ...}`. Token events carry the reply text. The final `done` event carries `products`, `cartProducts` and `compareProducts`.

In the Postman app the events appear one by one in the response pane.

request.description:
**Auth:** none

**Body:** `message` (string), `sessionId` (any string; the last 12 turns of history are kept per session for 1 hour).

`400` if either field is missing.

**Auth:** none

Greeting intent: canned reply, no product lookup.

**Auth:** none

Validation error example.

item.name: 07 - Admin
item.description:
Admin-only routes. They need a user with `role: "admin"` (set it in MongoDB; there is no API for promoting a user).

Set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` in the environment. If they are empty, every request in this folder is skipped. **Admin Login** replaces the regular user's cookies.

The Create → Update → Toggle → Delete requests clean up after themselves.

request.description:
**Auth:** none

Logs in as the admin from the environment.

exec: console.log("No admin credentials in environment - skipping admin folder.");

request.description:
**Auth:** admin

Same as the public list, but admin-gated. `403 Access denied - Admin only` for regular users.

exec: console.log("Skipping admin request - set adminEmail/adminPassword in the environment to run it.");

request.description:
**Auth:** admin

**Body:** `name`, `description`, `price`, `category`, `image` (base64 data URI **or** an image URL; it is uploaded to Cloudinary), `sizes` (optional, e.g. `["S","M"]`), `shoeSizes` (optional, e.g. `["UK 8"]`).

Also queues a Pinecone embedding for AI search. Returns `201` with the product.

    "name": "Postman Test Product",
    "description": "Created from the Postman collection - safe to delete.",
    "price": 19.99,
    "category": "accessories",
    "image": "https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/sample.jpg",
    "sizes": [],
    "shoeSizes": []
}

request.description:
**Auth:** accessToken cookie (non-admin)

Shows the `403 Access denied - Admin only` response. Skipped when the admin folder is logged in.

**Auth:** refreshToken cookie (optional)

**Auth:** none (expects 401)
